items.label: Heavy Duty Solid Wood Frame
items.value: The whole frame of the sofa set is made of premium acacia wood which is sturdy and not easy to crack or deform. And the parts are connected with premium screws so that the set is stable and will provide large weight capacity

items.label: Ergonomic Chair with Comfortable Cushion
items.value: Designed with slightly sloping backrest, the loveseat and single chair are close to your body shape. Plus, equipped with high resilience cushion, the set will provide the ultimate comfort to you. And the cover of cushion with hidden zipper is easy to take off and rinse by hand or machine

items.label: Multiple Combinations of Set
items.value: The 4-piece furniture set can be used separately or grouped in different ways to meet your different needs. It is enough space for 4-6 people and you can chat or have meals with your friends or family together. If you buy two sets, there will be more combinations for you

items.label: Versatile & Practical Sofa
items.value: Designed with concise style, the set with wood texture will be a good décor and bring warm atmosphere to your home. The sofa set is ideal to be placed in your garden, patio, balcony, poolside, backyard in your house to create a private corner

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: It is convenient to assemble the furniture set just following the instructions. And all neccessary tools are included. The dimension of every piece is as follows. Single Chair: 24 x 23 x 30.5 in (L x W x H), hold up 400 lbs. Loveseat: 50.5 x 23 x 30.5 in (L x W x H), hold up 800 lbs. Coffee table: 40 x 19.5 x 18.5 in (L x W x H), hold up 165 lbs

items.label: Tips
items.value: Do not use power tools to screws parts together. And if the item is damaged in assembly, we can reship that part if you can offer us picture. And before purchase, please read the size details again, to make sure the size is suitable for you. Thanks for your understanding

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1 x Coffee Table, 2 x Single Chairs, 1 X Loveseat, 2 x Single Chair Seat Cushions, 1 x Loveseat Seat Cushion, 1 x Instruction
